Installation

Installation guide

The basic steps for mortise door locks. Our regional service team can also carry out the installation.

1

Fit the lock body

Seat the lock body in the door pocket and fix it with the faceplate screws.

2

Route the cable

Offer up the outside panel and pass the connecting cable through the door to the inside panel.

3

Mount the panels

Place the front and rear panels on each face of the door and tighten the through-bolts.

4

Power up and enrol

Insert the battery, enrol fingerprints, faces, cards and PINs, then pair with the app.

These steps are a general guide; refer to the installation manual supplied with the product for details.

Model-specific installation notes

AEZ08Fingerprint Handle Lock for Timber Doors
  1. Bore the latch and spindle holes in the timber door (35–55 mm thick).
  2. Seat the latch and screw down its faceplate.
  3. Join the outside and inside panels over the spindle and tighten the screws.
  4. Insert 4 AAA batteries, enrol fingerprints and PINs, and pair over Bluetooth.
AEB05Smart Lock for Glass Doors
  1. Align the lock in position on the glass door.
  2. Place the lock body and the strike on the glass.
  3. Tighten the clamping screws to secure the lock.
  4. Insert 4 AA batteries and enrol fingerprints, PINs and cards.
AEN01Surface-Mounted Smart Rim Lock
  1. Mark the panel and lock case positions on the door and drill the holes.
  2. Screw the metal lock case to the inside face of the door.
  3. Fit the panel outside and connect the cable to the lock case.
  4. Insert the batteries, pair with the Tuya app and enrol users.
AES01Smart Cylinder Lock
  1. Loosen the fixing screw on the door edge and remove the existing cylinder.
  2. Fit the smart cylinder, set to the right length between 60 and 90 mm.
  3. Check the cam turns freely and tighten the screw.
  4. Insert 3 AAA batteries, pair over Tuya Bluetooth and enrol users.
AEC01Keypad Smart Window Handle
  1. Undo the screws of the existing window handle and remove it.
  2. Slide the new handle onto the gear spindle.
  3. Tighten the screws and close the cover.
  4. Insert 4 AA batteries and set the PIN.
AEGC01Smart Cabinet Lock
  1. Drill the mounting hole in the cabinet door.
  2. Pass the lock body through and join it to the part on the inside face.
  3. Secure the lock to the door with the nut and screws.
  4. Insert 3 AA batteries and enrol PINs and cards.

Mobile app

The key in your pocket

Most of our locks run on Tuya Smart / Smart Life or TTLock. Manage the door from your phone and see who came in and when.

Remote unlock

On Wi-Fi models, open the door from anywhere and see the lock status live.

Guest PINs

Create timed or one-off PINs, so guests and service staff need no key handover.

Entry logs

Who came in, how and when: the full history is in the app.

Alerts and battery level

Get notified of failed attempts, tampering and low battery.

App features vary by model and connection type. Remote unlocking and instant notifications need a Wi-Fi connection. Screens are illustrative and shown in Turkish. Tuya Smart, Smart Life and TTLock are trademarks of their respective owners.
